_comment: Save-based MCM settings captured from save 'Starling 1' (Save7, 2026-10-05) by decoding the save's global-variable table and Papyrus script data, then diffing against each plugin's / script's shipped defaults. Auto-detected flags (Nemesis/MCO/TrueHUD detection, init markers, live state), Obsidian Weathers' seasonal values, and everything already shipped as files in 'Zenderal - Settings' are deliberately excluded. Smart NPC Potions' three changed sliders were captured later from 'Starling 1' Save22 (2026-10-07); its three NPC-type toggles were at their defaults.

swift_potion._comment: Swift Potion Reborn keeps its auto-use and hotkey settings as JContainers objects in the save. Its MCM can export them (Save Settings) to JCUser/SwiftPotion/*.json; these are the curator's exports of 2026-10-05 (hotkeys: Left=Restore Health, Up=Restore Mana, Right=Restore Stamina; auto-use off). The applier loads them exactly as the MCM's Load Settings buttons do.

horse_key._comment: Enderal's call-horse key (_00E_HorseFlute_SC.iMountHotkey on NQ06_Freda alias 6) defaults to L, the same key as Quick Light SE, so one press did both. Moved to K so the controller's D-pad-right double tap (Gamepad++ sends K) calls the horse and D-pad-left (L) only lights, as zenematics.com documents. Only changed while still at the default.

companion_panel._comment: Enderal 2.1's companion health panel (MCM toggle 'Actor Health Bars', widget skyui/companionpanel.swf) is save-based: GLOB _00E_ActorHealthBarsEnabled 01598B:FS (default 1) plus the widget quest ActorHealthBarWidget 015989:FS's mod-event registration. The curator turns it off; Enderal's MCM does the same two steps (_00e_enderalmcm.psc OnOptionSelect).
